name: Rice bowl
intro: October's rice bowl is built on two things you made once: a tray of roasted sweet potato and a jar of salsa macha.
keep: Protein of choice (beef, chicken, beans, or nothing)
season_anchor: A spoonful of salsa macha, with its oil

variations.context: The version you'll make most often. Three minutes if the tray is in the fridge.

variations.ingredients: Ground beef + charred poblano + sweet potato
variations.context: The last of the chiles, doing their job.

variations.ingredients: Leftover braised chicken + white beans + lemon

finish: Something sharp, last — pomegranate or lime. October food is heavier than September's, and the squeeze matters more, not less.
